name: Authorized Web Platform Assessment
rulesOfEngagement: Operate only against approved demo, staging, and documentation assets. No exploitation, phishing, persistence, destructive testing, or credential validation outside approved test accounts.
objectives: Document exposed application surface and business-critical routes.
Track findings with evidence metadata suitable for client review.
Map assessment activity to manually selected MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
Maintain OPSEC and data-handling notes throughout the engagement.

findings.title: Missing defensive headers on staging portal
findings.summary: Manual review identified missing browser security headers on the approved staging portal response.
findings.recommendation: Add a centrally managed header policy for staging and production parity, then verify through release checks.

findings.title: API request correlation gaps
findings.summary: Approved API test traffic did not consistently include correlation IDs in downstream application logs.
findings.recommendation: Standardize request ID propagation across gateway, application, and SIEM pipelines.
